title: How large should a bogie-hearth furnace loading frame be? Check the chamber and the loaded assembly
summary: Loading-frame dimensions and furnace-chamber dimensions need separate agreement: one describes a fixture, the other the equipment's internal space. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s RT4-180-10 documents dated 30 March 2021 specify a 2200 × 1200 × 800 mm chamber and “maximum loading-frame external dimensions” of 1800 × 1000 × 700 mm. The latter are not defined as the overall limit for a fully loaded assembly. Workpiece projections, lifting lugs and spacers still require separate checks on the loading drawing.
